newsitem.title: USA: Modine to build $30 mln technical center.
newsitem.headline: Modine to build $30 mln technical center.

text.p: Modine Manufacturing Co said Monday it will spend $30 million over the next 2-1/2 years to expand its testing capabilities by building a technical center in Racine, Wis. devoted to heat-transfer technology.

Modine has maintained test laboratories of various kinds at its Racine, Wis. headquarters since the company was founded in 1916. Existing facilities include a vehicular wind tunnel that was the first in the world large enough to test a truck or bus under varying heat and power loads.
The new center will include an additional, larger, vehicular wind tunnel with sub-zero and tropical temperature capability and a high-horsepower dynamometer set.
It will be capable of simulated road-driving conditions from idle speed to 150 m.p.h.
First occupancy of the new center is scheduled for September 1998.
Modine provides heat-transfer technology serving vehicular, industrial, commercial and building markets.
